name: Wayward Weapons
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
narrative.objectives: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for returning these weapons, Sparkled. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
narrative.requestItemsText: Throm'ka, champion. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
